description.value: Gourmet Donuts & Coffee is a specialty donut and coffee shop occupying Unit 101 of a strip commercial development on Fraser Highway in Surrey. It sits along a busy arterial corridor, making it a convenient quick-stop option for cyclists transiting through the Fraser Valley. The shop specializes in donuts alongside coffee service.
